minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, May 15, 2024

  ACTION MINUTES
  “see items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at: 10:03 AM on Wednesday, May 15th, 2024.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan,
  and Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: Jenny Jolly.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community
  Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Bette Donovan to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, April 17th, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 27 participants per week
  in April.

  Meals on Wheels: 702 meals were served in the month of April.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through May 15th, 2024, was
  $39.00 Deposit of $360.00. The average attendance for April/May was 42
  players per week.

5. Account Balance: $2,543.29

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for April except for Bridge and Bingo.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Still in Spring Session.

8. Aging Next: 2 La Verne residents were served in April.
   New Business

9. Facilities Report: Skylight installation completed at the La Verne Community
  Center.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Thursday, June 6th – Excursion, Dodger Stadium and Grand Central Market, 8:45AM-
  4:45PM.
  - Monday, June 10th–Movie Matinee, The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel, 12:30PM.
  - Thursday, June 13th – Excursion, Colorful Songs of Broadway Patsy Cline & Johnny
  Cash Tribute, 10:45AM-4:30PM.

11. Public Comments: Congratulations to Terry and Edward on their awards. Yvonne
  Duran is working on the budget for community service. Pre-school will be
  wrapping up soon. The high school graduation on June 6th will cause the streets
  to be very crowded. Durwood will be section off for the Graduation. The
  Community Center and City Hall will be closing at 4:00PM on that day. George
  Borst stated that Senior Gold league broke a twenty-three-year-old jinx by getting
  a hole in one. Bette Donovan, researching the costs of paper, pencils, and prizes
  for bunko.

12. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:36AM. The next meeting will be on
  Wednesday, June 19th, 2024 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:

  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
